chat.t: Hello.
My boss referred me to you. My name is Hinata.
One of our subcontractors hasn't delivered their goods even though the deadline has passed.
So I'm contacting you to ask for your help.

o: Why are you asking me for this?

chat.t: I need to press them to deliver as soon as possible, but...
I was told you were the perfect person for the job.
Could you please help me...?
So you'll help me?

o: Since it's a request, I assume there's a reward?

chat.t: Of course. I've prepared a reasonable fee.
Thank you for your help today.
And... I'm so sorry.

o: I thought you were a mature secretary, but...

chat.t: I usually don't act like this in front of outsiders...
I just lost control of myself...
Anyway!
I'll send you the payment as soon as the processing is complete.

o: You'll have to include a fee for comforting you too.

chat.t: That wasn't in the original request...

o: It was a lot of work calming you down. I deserve a little extra for the trouble.

chat.t: Ugh...
I'll discuss it internally.
I'll get back to you once a decision is made.

lines.t: A Cafe in Humanitas
When I arrived at the café, I spotted the cute, bespectacled girl from the profile picture.
Nobody else was around, yet she was there smiling all by herself.
Over here, over here!
You look exactly like your picture.
Picture?
Oh, I just meant a photo I checked beforehand.
Please don't worry about it.
More importantly...
Are you sure you're okay with this?
Things could get out of hand if we're not careful...
Like a physical altercation, for instance?
Don't worry.
I've always wanted to try this at least once.
You wanted to try it?
You know, like a movie-style debt collection.
I... see...
You really are as unique as I've heard...
In front of the subcontractor's office
We're from Midwen Corporation.
Is anyone there?
Anyone inside?
Hello?
Maybe they're not in today.
It'll be a real problem if the delivery is delayed any further...
Move aside for a second.
Huh?
What are you going to do...?
Kicking the door.
(BANG! BANG!)
You're going to break the door!
Look who finally came out.
Are you going to pay for the office door if it breaks?
What are you, some kind of thug?

I'm no thug.
I have a savings account and insurance just like everyone else.
You look like you're very proud of yourself.
Don't worry about it.
I've always wanted to say that line.
A line you've always wanted to say...?
Well, at least we got the owner to show.
Oh, right!
*Ahem*.
We are from Midwen Corporation.
The deadline has long passed, but the goods have still not been delivered.
We would appreciate it if you could make the delivery quickly...
It's not like we're holding back because we don't want to deliver.
We have our reasons for the delay.
They say Midwen Corporation is a black company,but I didn't know you guys enjoyed bullying helpless small businesses this much.
B-Bullying?!
The deadline was proposed by you, ma'am, and we are only rightfully demanding delivery now that the date has passed...
Oh, I don't care about any of that.
Either wait or sue us! Do whatever you want!
But the agreed-upon deadline is...
I said, I don't care!
If that's how it's going to be, there's only one way left.
A good beating is the only cure for someone who won't listen.
History has proven it time and again.
Huh?!
W-Wait a minute!
I don't know how to fight...
I'm sorry! I'm sorry!

I will deliver the goods first thing tomorrow!
Please, just let me off this once!
What do you mean, tomorrow?
Deliver it today.
Hiiik...!

Y-Yes, understood!
I'll make sure it's delivered today, no matter what!
And that's another case closed, client.
Th-Thank... you...
We... solved it...
It wasn't exactly the method I expected, though...
What's with that lukewarm reaction?
It was a clean resolution. Aren't you happy?
But...
U-Ugh...
U-Ugh?
Waaaaah!
I'm already dying from all the paperwork and fieldwork and everything else!
I know it's my job, but now I'm expected to fight when I don't even know how!
I can't live like this!
I'm really going to die of overwork!
Why are you crying all of a sudden?!

After securing a promise from the subcontractor owner to deliver today,
I barely managed to soothe the sobbing Hinata and head back.

chat.t: The payment amount has been finalized and processed.
It has been decided to offer you an additional bonus as well.
Where should I send the payment?
Cash? In an apple box? Why such an old-fashioned way...
I can split the Credits across several cards for you, but it would be incredibly tedious to handle.

o: I've always wanted to receive a mountain of cash in an apple box.

chat.t: But why go to such lengths...
Ugh...
Alright.
Then I will hand it over at the café where we first met.

lines.t: A certain café

I arrived at the café where I first met Hinata.
Even though I was right on time, she wasn't there.
It was only after a few minutes had passed that she finally appeared.
(Huff, puff...)
Whew.
I'm sorry I'm late.
It took some time to split the Credits and pack them into this apple box.
You're not supposed to carry an apple box of cash so openly.
Huh?
Then how...?
You have to unload it directly from a truck.
How am I supposed to find a truck on such short notice?
Make it happen. Just make it happen.
Could you hold on a second?
I'll try to find one...
In front of the Hideout
Phew.
As requested, we unloaded it from a truck.
Is this satisfactory?
Great. No problems here.
Well, now that the payment has been delivered, I must be going...
Tell you what.
I'll buy you a cup of coffee.
Thank you for the offer, but I still have some work to do afterward...
In times like this, you're supposed to say thank you and accept it.
No, but I really have to finish...
Now, now.
...Yes.

Despite claiming she was busy, the moment Hinata sat down, she began pouring her heart out.
This went on for thirty minutes.
I already have a mountain of work, yet they keep piling more on top.
I want to take a vacation and rest, but then nothing gets done...
I really don't know if I'm working to live or living to work!
...Hey.
Huh?
I've been watching you this whole time, and...
You really can't say no to anyone, can you?
I'm only human, of course I can say no.
If it's something I can't do, I firmly decline.
I don't think so.
In that case, can you refuse my request?
Of course.
If it's something I can't do, I will naturally refuse.
Show me the panties you're wearing.
Huh?!
M-My u-underwear?!
I'd like you to lift your skirt with both hands and show me.
No matter how you look at it, there's no way I'd suddenly show you my underwear!
Maybe if we were dating...
Just show me once.
No matter how much you ask...
It's the favor of a lifetime.
Well, if it's really just once...

Right before her panties were revealed, we were kicked out by the café owner,
who yelled that public indecency was forbidden inside.
Hinata suddenly remembered an urgent matter and rushed back in a hurry.

chat.t: Um...
Could I ask you for some advice?

o: Anytime, as long as you show me your panties.

chat.t: Urrrgh...
T-Then, I'll show you, so please do me a favor!
Lately, I've been hearing a lot that I have no guts.
So, I really want to learn how to carry myself with some boldness, no matter what.
But there isn't really anyone around who can teach me...

o: I'm not sure if that's something you can just learn.

chat.t: Y-Yes, understood!
We had a few minor incidents, but...
I'm really grateful for today's advice.
When I told the president what I learned, she seemed quite pleased with it.
I want to do something to repay you, but...

o: I'll charge you a low consultation fee.

chat.t: So it comes down to money in the end?
Should I pack it in an apple box for you like last time?

o: No, remember the promise we made today?

chat.t: A promise we made today...?
Please just forget about my breasts already!

lines.t: A Cafe in Humanitas
Hinata had already arrived at the cafe, holding a pen and a notepad.
The cafe owner was watching Hinata with a suspicious look.
Over here! Over here!
I've already ordered your drink.
Goddess's Milk Tea' right?
Forget the drink. Where are the panties?
Do I really have to show you...?
Well, last time we got kicked out when I tried to show you, so maybe we should leave the cafe first...
I told you, I'm just kidding...
At this rate, you'd probably let me feel your breasts too.
Underwear is one thing, but there's no way I'd let you touch my breasts!
Are you sure about that?
Wh-Why are you looking at me with such serious eyes all of a sudden...?
And why are you getting on your knees?!
I'm not getting up until you say, 'Fine, just touch them already!'
What on earth...
Everyone is staring at us!
Urrrgh...
Kh! Just touch them!
Fine, just touch them already!
There you go.
U-Ugh...
What do you mean, 'there you go'...
This is what having guts is all about.
This is... having guts...!
Let me ask you one thing.
What was the most prominent feature of my behavior just now?
The most prominent feature of your behavior?
Spirit? Confidence?
It's grit. Ruthless grit.
Ruthless grit...?
The ruthless grit to get things done, no matter what.
The grit to say, 'if I fail, I'm taking you down with me.'
That's the kind of grit I'm talking about.
...You're right!
You need that kind of fierce mindset to actually have some guts!
I think I'm starting to understand.
What it means to have guts.
In that sense, you're actually a very gutsy person.
Huh?
Me? How could I...
If they had to pick the toughest person in your company, you'd probably win.
You're a crybaby, but you always get the job done. That makes you the toughest of them all.
It feels like the kind of logic where it's earrings if you hang it on your ears, and a nose ring if you hang it on your nose...
Can someone really be called tough just for doing their job?
...Is that the kind of thinking I'm supposed to throw away?
You catch on quick.
I'm still a bit confused, but I think I'm starting to get it.
Thank you for the advice.
Well, I should head out now...
Hold on.
Is there something else you wanted to say?
I haven't touched your breasts yet.
So that wasn't just something you said to enlighten me?
A little bit of both.
Excuse me, customer.Cafe Owner
I've been watching you closely.Cafe Owner
As I told you last time, lewd behavior is prohibited inside the shop.Cafe Owner
In the end, I had to head back without ever touching Hinata's breasts.
And I was permanently banned from the cafe.
